verdicts.decision_note: First concrete discovery of a distinct failure state: 823 apparently malicious pages were attributed to a user, and the client confirmed that the non-HLX pages were unauthorized.
The client unambiguously accepts deletion of content created by cobalt_orchard_13, establishing an implementation-relevant database and backend cleanup rule.
Target-specific implementation claim reporting the first concrete cleanup progress: 823 posts and 9 pages were manually removed while content identification continued.
Distinct completion claim following partial cleanup: the freelancer reports removal of all approximately 830 identified casino-spam pages.
Distinct later cleanup claim covering an additional unauthorized content type: residual spam post tags were located and cleared.
